WHERE al.reason_cleared STARTS WITH 'isolated cluster'

       al.signals AS signals, a.id AS account, a.bank_id AS bank,
       coalesce(a.component_size, 0) AS component_size

cypher:
MATCH (a:Account) WHERE a.id IN $ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a)
RETURN a.id AS id, a.bank_id AS bank, 'account' AS kind,
       coalesce(a.pagerank, 0.0) AS pagerank, coalesce(a.motif_score, 0.0) AS motif,
       a.community AS community, collect(DISTINCT c.id) AS cases

MATCH (s:Account)-[f:FLOWS]->(d:Account)
WHERE s.id IN $ids AND d.id IN $ids
RETURN s.id AS source, d.id AS target, f.capacity AS amount, f.n_txn AS n

MATCH (a) WHERE (a:Account OR a:ExternalAccount) AND a.id IN $ids
RETURN a.id AS id, a.bank_id AS bank,
       CASE WHEN a:Account THEN 'account' ELSE 'external' END AS kind

MATCH (s)-[t:TRANSFERS]->(d)
WHERE s.id IN $ids AND d.id IN $ids
RETURN s.id AS source, d.id AS target, sum(t.amount) AS amount, count(t) AS n

MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a:Account)
WITH c, collect(DISTINCT a.bank_id) AS banks, collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS ids
WHERE size(banks) >= 3
RETURN c.id AS id, c.title AS title, banks, ids
ORDER BY size(banks) DESC, size(ids) DESC LIMIT 1

OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Account) WHERE a.id IN $ids
WITH count(a) AS own
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[t:TRANSFERS]->(d) WHERE s.id IN $ids AND d.id IN $ids
RETURN own, count(DISTINCT [s.id, d.id]) AS links

MATCH (s:Account)-[:FLOWS]->(d:Account) WHERE s.id IN $ids AND d.id IN $ids
RETURN count(*) AS links

independence.cypher:
MATCH (c:Claim {id:$id})-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e:Evidence)
WHERE e.state IN ['active', 'needs_verification']
RETURN count(e) AS paths, count(DISTINCT e.origin) AS independent_sources,
       collect(DISTINCT e.kind) AS kinds

cypher:
MATCH (e:Evidence {kind:'shared_attr'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Claim)-[r:SUPPORTED_BY|CHALLENGED_BY]->(e)
RETURN e.id AS id, e.origin AS origin, e.summary AS summary, e.state AS state,
       collect(DISTINCT {claim:c.id, text:c.text, rel:type(r), confidence:c.confidence}) AS claims

MATCH (e:Evidence {id:$id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Claim)-[:SUPPORTED_BY|CHALLENGED_BY]->(e)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Claim)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..3]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Action)-[:JUSTIFIED_BY]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Sentence)-[:CITES]->(e)
RETURN collect(DISTINCT c.id) AS claims, collect(DISTINCT d.id) AS derived,
       collect(DISTINCT x.id) AS actions, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS sentences

algorithms.title: Weakly connected components
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.wcc({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH componentId, collect(node.id) AS ids, collect(DISTINCT node.bank_id) AS banks
RETURN componentId, size(ids) AS size, size(banks) AS n_banks, ids[0..50] AS sample
ORDER BY size DESC

algorithms.title: Label propagation communities
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.labelPropagation({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
                            maxIterations:$iters})
YIELD node, communityId
WITH communityId, collect(node.id) AS members, collect(DISTINCT node.bank_id) AS banks
WHERE size(members) >= $min_size AND size(members) <= $max_size
RETURN communityId, members, banks, size(members) AS size
ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT $limit

algorithms.title: PageRank hubs
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.pageRank('Account', 'TRANSFERS') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS account, node.bank_id AS bank, score
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $k

algorithms.title: Betweenness bridges (sampled)
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.betweenness({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
                       samplingSize:$samples, samplingSeed:$seed})
YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS account, node.bank_id AS bank, score
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $k

algorithms.title: Harmonic centrality
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.HarmonicCentrality({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS']})
YIELD node, score, reachable
RETURN node.id AS account, node.bank_id AS bank, score, reachable
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $k

algorithms.title: Shortest money paths
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (s:Account {id:$src}), (d:Account {id:$dst})
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode:s, targetNode:d, relTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
                   maxLen:$max_len, pathCount:$path_count, relDirection:$direction})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.id] AS accounts,
       [t IN relationships(path) | t.txn_id] AS txn_ids,
       [t IN relationships(path) | t.amount] AS amounts,
       pathWeight AS hops

algorithms.title: Single-source reach
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (s:Account {id:$src})
CALL algo.SSpaths({sourceNode:s, relTypes:['TRANSFERS'], maxLen:$max_len, pathCount:1})
YIELD path, pathWeight
WITH last(nodes(path)) AS n, pathWeight
RETURN n.id AS account, n.bank_id AS bank, min(pathWeight) AS hops
ORDER BY hops LIMIT $limit

algorithms.title: Max flow (money at risk)
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (s:Account) WHERE s.id IN $sources
WITH collect(s) AS srcs
MATCH (t:Account) WHERE t.id IN $targets
WITH srcs, collect(t) AS tgts
CALL algo.maxFlow({sourceNodes:srcs, targetNodes:tgts, relationshipTypes:['FLOWS'],
                   capacityProperty:'capacity', nodeLabels:['Account']})
YIELD maxFlow, edges, edgeFlows
RETURN maxFlow, [e IN edges | [startNode(e).id, endNode(e).id]] AS flow_edges, edgeFlows

algorithms.title: Breadth-first reach
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (s:Account {id:$id})
CALL algo.bfs(s, $depth, 'TRANSFERS') YIELD nodes
RETURN [n IN nodes | n.id] AS reached

algorithms.title: Minimum spanning forest backbone
algorithms.cypher:
CALL algo.MSF({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
               weightAttribute:'amount'})
YIELD edges
UNWIND edges AS e
RETURN startNode(e).id AS src, endNode(e).id AS dst, e.txn_id AS txn_id, e.amount AS amount

algorithms.title: Full-text, Double Metaphone
algorithms.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Person', $q) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.name AS name, node.id AS person, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10

algorithms.title: Full-text, English stemming
algorithms.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Chunk', $q) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS chunk, substring(node.text, 0, 160) AS text, node.sources AS sources, score
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5

algorithms.title: Vector KNN (HNSW, cosine)
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (a:Account {id:$id})
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Account', 'behavior_vec', $k, a.behavior_vec) YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS account, node.bank_id AS bank, score ORDER BY score

algorithms.title: JS UDF aml_temporal.timeRespectingReach
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (a:Account {id:$id})
WITH a, aml_temporal.timeRespectingReach(a, $hops, $window) AS reach
UNWIND reach AS r
RETURN r.account AS account, r.bank AS bank, r.hops AS hops, r.arrived AS arrived,
       r.amount AS amount, r.back_to_start AS back_to_start
ORDER BY hops, arrived LIMIT 50

algorithms.title: FLEX jaroWinkler + levenshtein
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p, flex.text.jaroWinkler(toLower(p.name), toLower($q)) AS jw
WHERE jw > 0.85
RETURN p.name AS name, jw, flex.text.levenshtein(toLower(p.name), toLower($q)) AS edits
ORDER BY jw DESC LIMIT 10

algorithms.title: FLEX sim.jaccard over identity attributes
algorithms.cypher:
MATCH (a:Account)-[:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]->(x)<-[:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]-(b:Account)
WHERE a.id < b.id
WITH a, b, count(DISTINCT x) AS shared LIMIT 200
MATCH (a)-[:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]->(xa)
WITH a, b, shared, collect(DISTINCT xa.id) AS sa
MATCH (b)-[:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]->(xb)
WITH a, b, shared, sa, collect(DISTINCT xb.id) AS sb
RETURN a.id AS a, b.id AS b, shared, flex.sim.jaccard(sa, sb) AS jaccard
ORDER BY jaccard DESC, shared DESC LIMIT 10

algorithms.title: Tri-modal: full-text + vector + SPpaths in one query
algorithms.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Person', $name) YIELD node AS p, score AS text_score
WITH p, text_score ORDER BY text_score DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (p)-[:OWNS]->(seed:Account)
WITH p, text_score, seed LIMIT 1
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Account', 'behavior_vec', $k, seed.behavior_vec)
YIELD node AS twin, score AS vec_score
WITH p, text_score, seed, twin, vec_score WHERE twin <> seed
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode:seed, targetNode:twin, relTypes:['FLOWS'],
                   maxLen:$flow_hops, pathCount:1, relDirection:'both'})
YIELD path, pathWeight
RETURN p.name AS matched_name, text_score, seed.id AS seed, seed.bank_id AS seed_bank,
       twin.id AS twin, twin.bank_id AS twin_bank, vec_score,
       [n IN nodes(path) | n.id] AS path, pathWeight AS hops
ORDER BY vec_score LIMIT 5

notes: Account level: an account is illicit if it is an endpoint of >=1 laundering transaction (IBM labels).
Dev = alerted accounts whose first alert falls in the earlier half of the period; test = the later half. Weights and thresholds come from dev only.
graph_calibrated uses labels from the dev split to fit 41 feature weights; graph_hand_weights uses none.
These rows evaluate the graph decision; the LLM only reviews scores near the threshold in the live agent and is not part of these numbers.
A bank can only investigate (KYC, other transfers) its own customers; accounts held is the share of the ring it can actually work on.
Attempt ground truth: connected_components_of_laundering_transfers; laundering transfers identified by IBM's per-transaction label.

motif uses the paper's HI-Small parameters (gamma=0.8). motif_no_degree_penalty (gamma=0) is a post-hoc ablation added after seeing that the degree penalty inverts the score on this slice (see account_auc); treat it as exploratory.
We use FalkorDB PageRank in place of eigenvector centrality (not available natively).
Our graph is the top-20-bank consortium slice of HI-Small, not the paper's full largest WCC, so absolute ratios are not directly comparable.
Parameters are the paper's Ethereum settings adapted to IBM data (T=24h, similarity 0.98, min amount 1000, min 3 pairs); not tuned on test labels.
No GNN: risk field = motif score, PageRank, pass-through pairs and behaviour-vector similarity; context = time/amount-consistent transfer pairs.
theta=0 so every round adds nodes, exposing the precision/recall trade-off.
Echo and gate figures are measured over the cases the agents produced in this graph.
Writer-vs-auditor ablation needs an OpenRouter key and is reported separately when run.
Single local machine; no comparison with other databases was run.

MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a:Account)
WHERE $case IS NULL OR c.id = $case
RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS id LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account) WHERE a.id IN $ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a)
RETURN a.id AS id, a.bank_id AS bank, 'account' AS kind,
       coalesce(a.pagerank, 0.0) AS pagerank, coalesce(a.motif_score, 0.0) AS motif,
       a.community AS community, collect(DISTINCT c.id) AS cases

MATCH (s:Account)-[f:FLOWS]->(d:Account)
WHERE s.id IN $ids AND d.id IN $ids
RETURN s.id AS source, d.id AS target, f.capacity AS amount, f.n_txn AS n

MATCH (s)-[t:TRANSFERS]->(d)

RETURN s.id AS source, d.id AS target, sum(t.amount) AS amount, count(t) AS n

MATCH (a:Account)-[:TRANSFERS]-(x:ExternalAccount) WHERE a.id IN $ids
RETURN DISTINCT x.id AS id, x.bank_id AS bank LIMIT $limit

MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a:Account) WHERE a.id IN $ids
WITH c, collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS accounts
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_CLAIM]->(cl:Claim)
RETURN c.id AS id, c.title AS title, c.status AS status, accounts,
       collect(DISTINCT {id:cl.id, kind:cl.kind, state:cl.state}) AS claims

/lab/memory.cypher:
MATCH (p:Procedure)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:STEP]->(s:Step)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:FAILED_BEFORE]->(x:Pitfall)
WITH p, r, s, collect(x.note) AS pitfalls ORDER BY r.order
RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.typology AS typology, p.success_count AS success,
       p.fail_count AS fail, p.learned_from AS learned_from,
       collect({order:r.order, tool:s.tool, params:s.params_template, why:s.why,
                pitfalls:pitfalls}) AS steps
